title.narrative: Support to the Operationalization of e-Justice in Dakar Suburbs in Senegal

description.narrative: The joint project supports the Ministry of Justice´s Digital Justice Master Plan in Senegal. The Ministry aims at digitizing the judicial sector by dematerializing all its procedures and digitizing all information flows within each jurisdiction and local structures by 2027. The digitization of the justice sector addresses the challenges hindering access to justice for citizens, especially women and youth, and particularly those living in marginalized areas, by eliminating obstacles such as distance, costs, reducing the processing time of cases, and the lack of legal awareness among populations.
